title: Terraform PrivNet Security Composer: SG/NACL/Private-DNS/Egress orchestration
creator: Marina Cho
description: Purpose: Build a single, composable Terraform module (PrivNet Security Composer) that delivers a canonical set of security controls for Private/VPC deployments: scoped Security Groups (SGs), network ACL templates (NACLs), private hosted zone management (Private DNS), and opinionated egress policies with audit hooks. The module should be easy to include in Private deployment stacks, support safe upgrades across versions, and export health-check endpoints and metrics for the Console.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes stable inputs for SG rules, NACL templates, private-hosted-zone(s) mappings, and egress allowlists/blocklists.
Upgrade path: terraform state migration instructions and versioned resource naming ensure no downtime when moving from older modules to composer v1.0.
Module emits CloudWatch/Stackdriver-compatible health metrics and an optional health-check lambda that reports to the Console’s observability pipeline.
E2E test harness validates SG/NACL behavior in a test VPC and confirms DNS resolution for private zones.
Security review completed and KMS/HSM secrets are never stored in module state or outputs.
Documentation (README + upgrade notes) and a sample Private deployment stack in examples/complete are included.
Automated policy checks (rego/OPA or tfsec) pass in CI and a pre-merge pipeline blocks insecure defaults.
Has clear fallback behavior when egress restrictions would block platform telemetry; opt-in strict mode available.
checklist: Define input schema and default safe values for SG/NACL/egress/dns
Implement Terraform module (root->modules/security_composer) with submodules for SG, NACL, DNS, egress
Add data sources to look up existing private hosted zones and attach records
Implement health-check lambda + IAM role for read-only checks and metrics emission
Write stateful upgrade docs and provide a migration plan for common breaking changes
Wire CI: tflint, tfsec, unit tests using kitchen-terraform or terratest
Open draft PR and run integration tests in staging account
Coordinate security review and get sign-off from Compliance
Prepare rollout plan (canary by account tag -> wider rollouts)
Add console telemetry hooks (token-level cost/latency not applicable but health/trace tags needed)
updates: 2026-02-16 - Marina Cho: Kickoff meeting with Infra and Security. Agreed on four deliverables: SG templates, NACL templates, private DNS wiring, egress policy engine. Decided to provide an "opinionated safe" default and explicit opt-ins for stricter modes.

2026-02-22 - Diego Alvarez: PoC for SG/NACL composition completed. Verified that modular approach avoids duplicate security group rules and reduces rule count by grouping by purpose (control-plane, data-plane, egress). PoC repo: github.com/redwood/privnet-security-composer/poc

2026-02-28 - Diego Alvarez: Identified upgrade risk: older stacks use non-versioned security group names. Proposed solution: introduce stable resource prefixes and an optional migration step using terraform state mv with a helper script in scripts/migrate-names.sh

2026-03-04 - Security (Anika Rao): Initial threat modelling review. Concern: egress allowlist defaults may cause telemetry loss. Agreed to add a telemetry-exceptions list and an explicit Console-telemetry boolean input.

2026-03-08 - Diego Alvarez: Implemented health-check lambda (python) that validates NACL handshake, resolves a sample private DNS entry, and makes a small HTTPS call to a Redwood observability endpoint. Lambda emits metrics under namespace 'privnet/security-composer'.

2026-03-10 - QA (Liam Turner): Integration tests passing in staging with minimal example. Found intermittent timing issue where NACL propagation lags in test infra — added retry with exponential backoff to test harness and documented eventual consistency expectations.

2026-03-12 - Marina Cho: Draft PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1829. Requesting review from infra, platform security, and SDK owners. Planning canary rollout to two internal accounts after sign-off.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge after Security sign-off and CI green. 2) Canary deploy to two non-critical internal accounts (tagged 'canary-privnet'). Monitor health metrics for 48 hours. 3) If stable, enable module in pilot customer account under feature flag. 4) Full rollout across Private region accounts with 24-hour stagger. Provide rollback instructions (revert module version + run migration reversal script if needed).
test_plan: Unit tests for terraform plan/diff, tfsec/lint in CI, terratest as integration tests in a disposable VPC, and a staged canary with health-check lambda asserting DNS resolution and egress connectivity. Manual penetration test for egress policy edge cases before production rollout.
